evidence_tier: REAL. WP2 Phase 0: m(alpha, n_cal) on claims, temper family, fresh seed 20260820. alpha {0.05, 0.10} x n_cal {100, 250, 1000, 4000, 10000}; the 100 and 10000 endpoints are the mandated extremes, both outside every previously tested budget.
question: Does the amplification factor m depend on the calibration budget? The leading Phase 1 mechanism (H2: the threshold solves a NOISY empirical estimating equation, and threshold noise against a convex loss curve Jensen-amplifies excess) requires m to fall toward a limit as n_cal grows. This registration commits to that mechanism's signature BEFORE the mechanism hunt begins.

predictions.P0B-1: RISKY, mechanism-committal: m is strictly decreasing in n_cal at both alphas (Spearman(m, n_cal) = -1 over the five-point grid at each alpha), and the total drop at alpha 0.05 is large: m(0.05, 100) - m(0.05, 10000) >= 0.15.
predictions.P0B-2: The alpha-dependence survives budget crossing: m(0.05, n_cal) > m(0.10, n_cal) at every n_cal where both are measurable.
predictions.P0B-3: Mean control is budget-insensitive (replicating F16's mean rows on fresh seeds): the oracle aggregate margin b is <= 0 + 2 SE at all 10 (alpha, n_cal) grid points, including n_cal = 100 where the B/(n+1) charge is 25 to 50 times larger relative to alpha.
predictions.P0B-4: The H2 ingredient measured directly: sd(lambda_hat) scales with n_cal at a power in [-0.6, -0.35] (log-log regression across the grid, per alpha). Unlike F16's realized-risk dispersion (floored by the evaluation window at exponent 0.32), threshold dispersion has no evaluation-side floor and should track root-n.

falsifiers.P0B-1: If the total decrease is < 0.08 at BOTH alphas, H2 is dead on arrival: empirical-crossing noise cannot be the main owner of m, and Phase 1 starts with H2 demoted and H1/H3/H4 promoted. This is the registration's reason to exist; a flat m is the single most informative miss available this phase.
falsifiers.P0B-2: An inversion (m(0.05) <= m(0.10) at some budget) would tie the alpha-dependence to a budget interaction no current mechanism predicts; register a follow-up before narrating.
falsifiers.P0B-3: Standing bug-presumption path; a violation at n_cal = 100 specifically implicates the finite-sample term handling.
falsifiers.P0B-4: An exponent shallower than -0.35 means threshold noise is floored by something other than calibration count (score discreteness is the named suspect: on a plateau, the threshold cannot move by less than one plateau step, capping the resolution); that reading feeds H1 rather than H2 and is stated here in advance.

decision_rule: m per (alpha, n_cal): through-origin regression of measured kappa on kappa_pred over guarded temper cells, guards as registered in the battery (|a| >= 0.003, slope_what >= 0.02, ratio-of-trial-means kappa_pred at h = 0.05). sd(lambda_hat) recorded per cell as the across-trial standard deviation of the estimated arm's mean per-test threshold; grid exponent by OLS on log-log means per alpha. Verdicts prediction-by-prediction, misses verbatim.
notes: No disclosed probe of the m(n_cal) direction exists; the 20-trial budget probe in the design audit failed its own guards (per-trial ratio instability) and was not re-run, deliberately: P0B-1's direction and size come from the H2 mechanism alone, which is what makes it risky rather than fitted. n_cal = 10000 cells cost about 10x the standard cells; 300 trials are kept anyway.

verdicts.P0B-1: PARTIAL, the informative way, misses verbatim. The mechanism-committal content holds decisively: m falls with budget by 1.24 at alpha 0.05 (2.496 to 1.256) and 1.42 at alpha 0.10 (2.527 to 1.106), an order of magnitude beyond the 0.08 kill threshold, so H2 is alive and owns the budget-dependent component. Two registered clauses missed: (i) Spearman is not -1 at either alpha because the 4000-to-10000 step RISES by +0.001 at both alphas (noise-level, but the registered word was strictly); (ii) m(0.05, 100) is unmeasurable (1 guarded cell; the anticipated guard starvation realized). THE FINDING BEYOND THE REGISTRATION: m does not decrease toward 1; it plateaus at a limit above 1 that is itself alpha-dependent (about 1.10 at alpha 0.10, about 1.25 at alpha 0.05; the 4000 and 10000 points agree within 0.001 at both alphas). A budget-independent mechanism carries part of the amplification, and per operating principle 3 this anomaly gets a registered follow-up: the Phase 1 switchboard's H3 discriminator (P-SW4) targets exactly this plateau.
verdicts.P0B-2: CONFIRMED at all four measurable budgets: m(0.05) > m(0.10) at n_cal 250 (2.496 vs 1.375), 1000 (1.387 vs 1.151), 4000 (1.255 vs 1.105), 10000 (1.256 vs 1.106). The alpha-dependence survives budget crossing and persists into the plateau, so the budget-independent component is itself alpha-dependent.
verdicts.P0B-3: CONFIRMED: oracle aggregate margin b + 2SE < 0 at all 10 grid points (max -0.0032), including n_cal = 100 where the pseudo-loss charge is 25 to 50 times larger relative to alpha; the extra conservatism at 100 (b about -0.014 vs -0.004 at 1000) is the B/(n+1) term acting as designed.
verdicts.P0B-4: CONFIRMED: sd(lambda_hat) scales at exponent -0.454 (alpha 0.05) and -0.531 (alpha 0.10), both inside [-0.6, -0.35]. Threshold noise tracks root-n with no evaluation-side floor, in sharp contrast to F16's realized-risk dispersion exponent 0.32; the H2 ingredient is present and behaves as the mechanism requires.
